title: Public holidays in Thailand
author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: Public holidays in Thailand are controlled by the government. Most holidays are observed by both the public and private sectors.
^a Parts of the private sector may not observe these days as holidays.
^b Months in which the dates usually fall.
These observances are controlled by the government, but are not observed as holidays.
